def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, sat

    # Variables from base script and constraint sets
    folio_test_slab = Int('folio_test_slab')
    object = Int('object')
    object_ptr = Int('object_ptr')

    s = Solver()

    # --- Base script constraints ---
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)
    s.add(object == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 1 constraints ---
    s.add(object_ptr == 0)
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 2 constraints ---
    PAGE_SIZE = 4096
    s.add(object != 0)
    s.add(object >= PAGE_SIZE)

    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
